authority_boundary: Exact visible text is preserved for grounding; all other fields are research annotations and are not source wording.
claim_relevant_visible_text: Micron Technology, Inc. (Nasdaq: MU), a global leader in memory and storage solutions, today announced it has begun volume production of its HBM3E (High Bandwidth Memory 3E) solution. Micron’s 24GB 8H HBM3E will be part of NVIDIA H200 Tensor Core GPUs, which will begin shipping in the second calendar quarter of 2024.
precision_guard: The first sentence is a Micron volume-production Reality at this vintage. The H200 Q2 shipping language is forward-looking platform shipment timing and must not be rewritten as an already-realized customer/platform shipment on February 26.
researcher_paraphrase: Micron said HBM3E volume production had begun; its 24GB 8H product was intended for NVIDIA H200 GPUs expected to begin shipping in calendar Q2 2024.
source_title: Micron Commences Volume Production of Industry-Leading HBM3E Solution to Accelerate the Growth of AI
